experiment_template.research_question: Do construction checkpoints improve GLM repairs within 24 calls at 12K?
stop_conditions: 24 model attempts, 48 tokenizer attempts; zero retries; 1800 seconds per episode.
Infrastructure, source integrity or cleanup failure pauses unstarted dispatches.
USD 0.10 model reserve per episode, USD 0.80 total.

success_criteria.correctness: Full private repair/regression scores; passing patches reproduced.
success_criteria.coverage: 8 terminal episodes, four paired comparisons; retain failures.
success_criteria.integrity: Identical initial prompts, common transport/scoring; only construction checkpoint tools and phase text differ.
success_criteria.screen: More paired wins than losses, zero new false rejections, at most 20 percent mean token and elapsed increase.

records.falsifier: No repair gain or unacceptable cost.
records.mechanism: Earlier staging preserves opportunities for testing and revision.
records.scope: Two observed Svelte tasks, GLM at 12K, two repetitions; development pilot only.
records.statement: Construction checkpoints improve full repair completion under the fixed GLM budget.
